trends.name: Middle East Oil Supply Crisis
trends.summary: Saudi Arabia's oil production capacity has fallen by 600,000-700,000 barrels per day due to attacks on Khurais and Manifa fields, representing 5% of Saudi production. Israeli strikes on Hezbollah sites in Lebanon and Iranian attacks on Kuwait facilities signal escalating regional conflict threatening critical energy infrastructure. Iran demanding cryptocurrency tolls on Strait of Hormuz shipping adds geopolitical risk premium to crude.

trends.name: US Economic Growth Collapse
trends.summary: Official Q4 2025 GDP growth plummeted to 0.5% from 3.4% tracking estimates and 4.4% Q3 actual, representing massive economic deceleration. Personal income data shows rare decline with real incomes at lowest since December 2022 and subdued spending despite elevated core prices, signaling stagflation concerns. Market volatility surging with record $SPY trading volume suggesting investor uncertainty about economic trajectory.

trends.name: Software Sector Breakdown
trends.summary: Software stocks experiencing 'full-fledged breakdown' with potential for further downside, signaling shift in AI-driven market leadership. Salesforce commentary indicates enterprise software demand patterns changing despite AI boom, suggesting rotation away from legacy SaaS names toward AI infrastructure plays.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure Demand Surge
trends.summary: CoreWeave stock bouncing on new Meta deal as AI infrastructure providers capitalize on explosive cloud computing demand. Amazon CEO Jassy's defense of $200 billion AI spend signals major tech capex commitment despite economic slowdown, with investors increasingly backing AI infrastructure over traditional software.

trends.name: US-China Trade Tensions
trends.summary: US Trade Rep Greer confirms no auto deliverables planned for Trump-Xi meeting with Friday discussions on policy outcomes. US maintaining connected vehicle rules effectively barring Chinese autos from market, with assessment that Chinese automakers would struggle establishing US production. Signals ongoing trade friction despite diplomatic engagement.

trends.name: Banking Sector Resilience & Earnings
trends.summary: JPMorgan Chase and Royal Bank of Canada earnings offering catalyst opportunities amid broader financial sector reassessment. Block positioned as buy on expanding banking activities and rising efficiency, contrasting with concerns over UnitedHealth regulatory pressures from CMS. Financial sector at critical crossroads with divergent performance by subsector.

trends.name: AI Subscription Competition Heating Up
trends.summary: OpenAI launching $100/month ChatGPT Pro subscriptions to compete with Anthropic in premium AI services market. Reflects enterprise willingness to pay premium for advanced AI capabilities, creating new revenue streams for AI leaders but signaling intensifying competition in AI services sector.

trends.name: Tech Sector Labor Reductions
trends.summary: Disney planning layoffs of as many as 1,000 employees, extending tech/media industry workforce cuts. Survey shows 47% of college students considering major changes due to AI, signaling structural labor market shifts as automation accelerates.

trends.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary Valuation
trends.summary: Sunbelt Retail (IVT) reaching pricey valuations with pullback scenarios identified; American Airlines raising bag fees for basic economy. Consumer discretionary sector showing stretched valuations amid subdued spending and growing cost pressures, with airlines shifting revenue models upward.

trends.name: Lithium & Battery Supply Dynamics
trends.summary: Albemarle's pivot to sodium-ion technology highlighted as value trap risk despite lithium giant positioning. Broader question about lithium oversupply and transition to alternative battery chemistries affecting battery metal valuations and EV supply chain economics.

trends.name: Geopolitical Cease-Fire Uncertainty
trends.summary: Iran-US cease-fire approved but highly fragile, with Putin declaring Orthodox Easter ceasefire in Ukraine. Temporary truces creating 'war's over' rally trap that investors should exit, while underlying conflicts remain unresolved, creating whipsaw risk. NATO willing to play role in Strait of Hormuz security.

trends.name: Real Rates & Monetary Policy Direction
trends.summary: Real interest rates emerging as critical metric for true postwar monetary policy stance, with market implications for equities and fixed income. Discussions of policy normalization and rate expectations critical amid economic slowdown and inflationary pressures.
